name: User Deactivation Date
description: Blocks user accounts automatically on a configured deactivation date via cron.
project_description:
The module lets you set a deactivation date for any user account on the site via a "Deactivation date" field. User accounts with deactivation date in the past, will be deactivated during cron.

 Post-Installation 
 To use the "Deactivation date" field, just expose it in the form display. To view the date set for the user on the profile, expose the field in the view display.

 Recommended modules 
 
 Field permissions lets you change who can edit or view the "Deactivation date" value based on the permission system.
